observations.why: Imperative command to erase knowledge functions as a coercive pressure tactic — the speaker leverages positional authority to demand information suppression, with no argument or benefit offered.
Direct imperative to delete knowledge repeats the coercive demand from src-1, escalating from 'forget' to 'remove' — insistence through repeated, uncompromising commands.
